title: UDP Send
text: Send UDP message, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Remote IP address (’255.255.255.255’ for broadcast)} sets IP address from which to accept UDP packets; {Remote IP port} sets the number of remote IP port, {Local IP port source} sets the source of local IP port Automatically, {Local IP port} sets the number of local IP port and {Send buffer size (bytes)} sets the size of buffer that sends UDP packets. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Remote IP address (’255.255.255.255’ for broadcast)
params.values: IP address from which to accept UDP packets ’127.0.0.1’ (default) | IP address | string

params.name: Remote IP port
params.values: Number of remote IP port 25000 (default) | scalar in the range [1, 65535]

params.name: Local IP port source
params.values: Source of local IP port Automatically determine (default) | Specify via dialog

params.name: Local IP port
params.values: Number of local IP port -1 (default) | scalar in the range [1, 65535]

params.name: Send buffer size (bytes)
params.values: Size of buffer that sends UDP packets 8192 (default) | scalar in the range [1, 67108864]
